First result reaction_id 422121: mapped_rxn shows a complex reaction with many atoms, product_smiles is same as reactant? Actually product_smiles is same as mapped_rxn product side? Hard.

But the reactant_smiles includes a carbonyl (C=O) and the product side ends with [CH2][OH] indicating reduction to alcohol? The mapped_rxn shows product with [CH2][OH] at end, meaning conversion of carbonyl to alcohol (reduction). That matches DIBAL-H? DIBAL reduces ester to aldehyde, not alcohol. But maybe they consider reduction to alcohol (over reduction). The description says forming aliphatic hydroxyls, so product is alcohol. So template likely reduces ester to alcohol.

Thus the template we need is one of these. Which one matches our target molecule? Our target molecule is the one we have in input data? The precursors list are three SMILES that are likely the ester forms (with carbonyl). The product (target) would be the alcohol form (with CH2OH). The mapped_rxn of template 422121 shows product with [CH2][OH] at end, matching alcohol. So likely this is correct.
